description.p: Rasterloom is a native Linux raster image editor. It works with real layers and groups, layer masks and clipping masks, 27 blend modes plus pass-through groups, selections, a pressure-sensitive brush, eraser and clone stamp, non-destructive adjustment layers, filters and transforms.

It opens and saves OpenRaster (.ora) and its own .orp format, imports and exports layered PSD and PSB files with a merged composite that other programs can read, and opens and exports PNG, JPEG and TIFF.
Every pixel operation is tested byte-for-byte against an independently written reference implementation. Rasterloom is an original program and is not affiliated with any other image-editor vendor.

First milestone ("Foundation"): layers, groups, masks, 27 blend modes, selections, brush, eraser and clone stamp, eight adjustment layers, six filters, transforms, history, and PSD/PSB, OpenRaster, PNG, JPEG and TIFF input and output.
